desc:
🐺 Live as a gray wolf in a wild valley inspired by Yellowstone!

🦌 Hunt with your pack: chase down deer, latch on and bring them down together, or catch rabbits in the grass.
🏔️ Find a den across the valley, forests and mountains, or dig your own.
🐾 Raise pups in spring, or start life as a pup and grow up into a grown wolf.
🌦️ Seasons, rain, storms and winter snow, with day and night.
🦷 Earn Fangs and unlock rare coats: black, white and pied.
🌕 Howl, bark, growl and wag your tail with your pack.

Join a pack. Raise your pups. Survive the valley.
